qa: No, you can't. This card is only treated as [Dorulumon] for a DigiXros. Related Cards

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: This card is also treated as [Dorulumon] for DigiXros. [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, until the end of their turn, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects or unsuspend. [On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Piercing＞.
